description: Cancels one job of the caller's own audio queue (DELETE /queue/{id}). The unit is refunded ONLY if the analysis had not completed yet; during alignment, the analysis already delivered is kept, without refund. 409 when the job can no longer be cancelled. Needs the audio:write scope. Only call it when the user asked to stop that job.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_audio_analyze or jj_queue_list.

name: jj_queue_cancel_job
title: Cancel an audio analysis job
